headline: New India Retailing & Investment Limited discloses substantial acquisition in Chambal Fertilizers under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: New India Retailing & Investment Limited has filed a SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure on NSE regarding a substantial acquisition of shares in Chambal Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited, a listed fertilizer manufacturer. The disclosure triggers mandatory public announcement requirements under the Takeover Regulations.
detail: New India Retailing & Investment Limited submitted a formal disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to the National Stock Exchange on or before 16 June 2026. This disclosure is triggered when an acquirer crosses prescribed thresholds of shareholding in a listed company. Chambal Fertilizers & Chemicals is a publicly listed fertilizer and chemicals manufacturer. The disclosure initiates mandatory takeover timeline and open offer obligations depending on the acquisition percentage.
